Class GuiNodeFactory

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.view.gui.GuiNodeFactory
public class GuiNodeFactory extends Object
Stateless factory for the game screen's visual building blocks: image views, card/tile wrappers, rounded-corner clips, the selectable glow and resource-path resolution.

Holds no game state and no FXML references — every method depends only on its arguments, so the same instance can be shared by every collaborator of GameViewController.

    • cardWrapper

      public javafx.scene.layout.StackPane cardWrapper(String imagePath, boolean selectable)
      Wraps a card-sized image in a StackPane so a selectable glow renders outside the inner image's squircle clip (effects are clipped with content). Click handling is left to the caller.
      Parameters:
      imagePath - classpath resource for the card face
      selectable - whether to render the glow + hand cursor
      Returns:
      the wrapper; the inner ImageView is its first child

    • applyCornerClip

      public static void applyCornerClip(javafx.scene.image.ImageView iv, double w, double h, boolean roundLeft, boolean roundRight)
      Clips an ImageView to a rounded rectangle that matches the image's actual rendered bounds (accounting for preserveRatio letterboxing), rounding only the requested sides.

      Matching the rendered bounds avoids stray pixels at the corners when the source image aspect ratio differs from the fit box. Side selectivity lets a row of tiles read as a single strip: only the outer corners are rounded.

      The clip is recomputed whenever the image changes, since the rendered bounds are only known once an image is loaded.

      Parameters:
      iv - the image view to clip
      w - reference width
      h - reference height
      roundLeft - round the left corners
      roundRight - round the right corners
